official_task_documentation.description: Pick up the yellow bread and place it on the blue plate
official_task_documentation.comment: Real R1-A7 upper body, not a RoboDojo simulation task. The head is pinned (pitch 0.25 rad, yaw 0) so the head camera viewpoint is constant. The demonstrations use the right arm to pick and place; the left gripper stays open throughout. Success is judged by the operator, not by an automatic evaluator.

scoring.condition: The bread is lifted clear of the table but does not end up on the blue plate.
The bread rests on the blue plate and the gripper has released it.
